analysis.reasonEn: RSI attempts to exit oversold from 28.3 to 37.5. ADX at 40.8 shows a strong trend, but downside pressure (-DI 40.0) outweighs upside (+DI 13.5). MACD histogram remains negative at -0.2138, holding steady. No confirmed trend reversal signal, hence wait-and-see.
